senses: vt. 使减少到最低限度；贬低…的重要性；使最小化

ex.en: The Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT) site was chosen to minimize the telescope's visibility around the island and to avoid archaeological and environmental impact.
ex.zh: 当初“30米望远镜”选址时，尽量让其在岛内看来不那么显眼，同时避免对考古和环境造成影响。

minimize.usage: minim（最小）+ize→使最小→最小化。反义：maximize vt. 最大化；v.使减少到最低限度；使最小化

senses: v. 使减少到最少,使降到最低
n. 最低限度,最少量,最低点
minimum.usage: 同义smallest,lowest;反义maximum最大;与maximum对照记；mini（微小的，细小的）+m+um（名词后缀）→最小值；索引p412

ex.en: The agreement's minimum goal would not be reached.
ex.zh: 协议的最低目标将无法实现。

ex.en: The government raised the minimum wage to protect workers from exploitation.
ex.zh: 政府提高了最低工资以保护工人免受剥削。

ex.en: Applicants should have a minimum of three years' relevant work experience.
ex.zh: 申请者应至少有三年相关工作经验。

minister.usage: n.部长，大臣；牧师；公使 v.帮助；mini（小的）+ster（表示“人”）→古代的一些“大臣”称自己为小人→大臣。；索引p412

ex.en: He has been successfully elected Prime Minister.
ex.zh: 他已成功当选首相。

ex.en: The education minister announced a reform plan to reduce students' academic burden.
ex.zh: 教育部长宣布了一项减轻学生学业负担的改革计划。

ex.en: The prime minister is expected to visit Japan early next month.
ex.zh: 预计首相将于下月初访问日本。

senses: adj. (较小的;(较少的;(较)不重要的
n. 副修科目;未成年人
minor.usage: 反义major主要的;较大的/主修科目；索引p412

ex.en: The car was slightly damaged in the accident, and the driver suffered only minor injuries.
ex.zh: 汽车在事故中轻微受损，司机只受了轻伤。

ex.en: She is majoring in economics with a minor in statistics.
ex.zh: 她主修经济学，辅修统计学。

ex.en: This is a minor issue compared with the funding crisis facing the whole university.
ex.zh: 与整所大学面临的经费危机相比，这只是个小问题。

senses: n. 少数；少数民族；少数群体
minority.usage: 助记:minor(较少的)+ity(名词后缀)→少数；n.少数，少数派；少数民族，少 数群体 adj.少数的；少数民族的；索引p412

ex.en: Only a tiny minority of products are affected.
ex.zh: 只有极少数产品受到影响。

ex.en: In his book The Tipping Point, Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social epidemics" are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals.
ex.zh: 在《引爆点》一书中，马尔科姆·格拉德威尔指出，“社会流行风潮”很大程度上是由极少数特殊个体的行为推动的。

ex.en: Ethnic minority students receive extra support to help them adapt to campus life.
ex.zh: 少数民族学生获得额外支持，以帮助他们适应校园生活。

senses: n. 负号,减号,负值;缺点,不足

minute.usage: 又:up-to-the-minute最新(式);in a minute马上

senses: n. 奇迹,令人惊奇的人(或事)

mirror.usage: n.镜子；写照 vt.反映；与……相似

ex.en: Female participation on corporate boards may not currently mirror the percentage of women in the general population, but so what?
ex.zh: 目前女性在公司董事会中的参与度可能无法反映女性在总人口中所占的百分比，但那又怎样呢？

ex.en: Novels often mirror the social concerns of the age in which they are written.
ex.zh: 小说常常反映其创作时代的社会关切。

ex.en: She glanced at herself in the mirror before rushing out to catch the bus.
ex.zh: 她照了一下镜子，便匆匆出门去赶公交车。

senses: n. 恶作剧；伤害；顽皮；恶意
mischief.usage: mis-（坏）+chief（结果）→坏结果→损害。族mischievous a.淘气的；有害的

ex.en: The boys were scolded for the mischief they had caused in class.
ex.zh: 男孩们因在课堂上捣乱而受到训斥。

ex.en: False rumours can do great mischief to a company's reputation.
ex.zh: 虚假谣言会对公司的声誉造成极大损害。

ex.en: She looked up with mischief in her eyes, ready with another joke.
ex.zh: 她抬起头，眼里闪着调皮的神色，又准备好了一个玩笑。

senses: adj. 顽皮的,招惹是非的;恶意的

ex.en: It is a common misconception that lightning never strikes the same place twice.
ex.zh: 闪电绝不会两次击中同一地点，这是一种普遍的误解。

ex.en: The course aims to correct popular misconceptions about nutrition.
ex.zh: 这门课程旨在纠正人们对营养的普遍误解。

ex.en: His argument rests on the misconception that talent alone guarantees achievement.
ex.zh: 他的论点建立在仅凭天赋就能取得成就这一错误认识之上。

senses: n. [U] 失职；不当行为；管理不善
n. [常用pl.] 恶行；不义之举
adj. 痛苦的，可怜的；令人不快的
adj. 痛苦的；令人不快的
miserable.usage: adj.痛苦的，使人难受的 mode/məʊd(词频8)；索引p412

ex.en: Rather than concluding that children make parents either happy or miserable, Senior suggests we need to redefine happiness.
ex.zh: 西尼尔没有定论养孩子到底会使父母快乐还是痛苦，相反，她指出，我们需要重新定义幸福。

ex.en: Thousands of workers lived in miserable conditions before the labor laws were passed.
ex.zh: 在劳动法通过之前，成千上万的工人生活在悲惨的境况中。

ex.en: The cold and rainy weather made our camping trip absolutely miserable.
ex.zh: 寒冷多雨的天气使我们的露营之旅非常难受。

senses: n. 痛苦，悲惨；穷困；悲惨的生活
misery.usage: 发音类似“眯着睡”→只能眯眼小睡→痛苦，悲惨。

ex.en: People in earlier eras were surrounded by reminders of misery.
ex.zh: 早期时代，苦难的提示信息总是围绕着人们。

ex.en: The flood brought misery to thousands of families who lost their homes overnight.
ex.zh: 洪水给一夜之间失去家园的数千个家庭带来了苦难。

ex.en: He lived in poverty and misery after his business collapsed in the recession.
ex.zh: 他在经济衰退中生意倒闭后，生活贫困凄惨。

misfortune.usage: 辨析:misfortune强调肉体或物质上不幸,一般用语;disaster指人为和自然力造成的突然损失,含天灾人祸之意；mis（否定前缀）+fortune（运气，财富）→不幸，灾祸。

ex.en: He bore the misfortune of losing his job with surprising calm.
ex.zh: 他以出人意料的平静承受了失业的不幸。

ex.en: The charity helps families struck by misfortune.
ex.zh: 这家慈善机构帮助遭受不幸的家庭。

ex.en: It was her misfortune to fall ill on the day of the interview.
ex.zh: 不巧的是，面试那天她病倒了。

senses: v. 对……指导错误,把……引入歧途
vt. 带错方向；使误入歧途

ex.en: Robert F. Kennedy is cited because he misinterpreted the role of GDP.
ex.zh: 引用罗伯特·F.肯尼迪的话是因为他误解了GDP的作用。

ex.en: His silence was open to misinterpretation.
ex.zh: 他的沉默很容易被误解。

ex.en: The translation of legal texts must avoid any misinterpretation.
ex.zh: 法律文本的翻译必须避免任何曲解。

ex.en: A single misinterpretation of the data led the team to a false conclusion.
ex.zh: 对数据的一处误解使团队得出了错误的结论。

senses: vt. (misled) ①把……引错方向，把……引入歧途，误导
②使产生错误想法，使误信，欺骗
v. 误导，把……引入歧途，使误信
mislead.usage: make sb. do 使某人做；ensure sb. sth. 保证某人得到；cause sb. to do 使某人做；mislead sb. into thinking 使误以为；vt.把…带错路、把…引入歧途；mis（表示否定）+lead（领导；引领）→误导。

ex.en: A string of accidents, including the partial collapse of a cooling tower in 2007 and the discovery of an underground pipe system leakage, raised serious questions about both Vermont Yankee's safety and Entergy's management—especially after the company made misleading statements about the pipe.
ex.zh: 一连串事故，包括2007年一座冷却塔的局部倾塌以及一个地下管道系统的渗漏，都让佛蒙特州洋基核电站的安全和安特吉公司的管理水平受到了严重的质疑，特别是在公司对管道渗漏作出误导声明后。

ex.en: Advertisers were fined for making claims that could mislead consumers about the product's effectiveness.
ex.zh: 广告商因发布可能误导消费者对产品功效认识的宣传语而被罚款。

ex.en: Simplified statistics can mislead readers if the underlying assumptions are not explained.
ex.zh: 如果不解释背后的假设，简化过的统计数据可能会误导读者。

misleading.usage: 词根记忆：mis(wrong,错误的)+lead(引导)+ing(…的)→误导的；索引p412

ex.en: misleading cues
ex.zh: 误导性线索

ex.en: When the skills mismatch is in the broader economy, though, the focus usually turns to government to handle.
ex.zh: 然而，当技能不匹配出现在更宏观的经济中时，焦点通常会转向政府，由政府来出面解决。

senses: v. 随意搁置,乱放(而一时找不到)
adj. 不合时宜的；给错对象的
misplaced.usage: adj.不合时宜的；放错位置的；索引p412

ex.en: The researchers also argued that when we shy away from casual interactions with strangers, it is often due to a misplaced anxiety that they might not want to talk to us.
ex.zh: 研究人员还提出，我们回避与陌生人进行随意互动，往往是出于一种不应该有的焦虑，即担心他们可能不想和我们说话。

senses: vt. 错过机会；思念；未参加
v. 未击中,错过,没达到
miss.usage: 助记:在mist(雾)里猎人miss(未击中)猎物

senses: n. 导弹；投射物，发射物
missile.usage: miss（送）+ile（物体）→发送出去的物体→发射物

ex.en: The missile fell harmlessly into the sea.
ex.zh: 导弹落到了海里，没有造成任何伤害。

ex.en: The country test-fired a new ballistic missile last week.
ex.zh: 该国上周试射了一枚新型弹道导弹。

ex.en: Defence systems are designed to intercept missiles before they reach their targets.
ex.zh: 防御系统的设计目的是在导弹到达目标之前将其拦截。

senses: a. 找不到的；失踪的；被去除的；未被包括在内的
adj. 漏掉的,失去的,失踪的
n. 任务,使命;传教,布道
n. 使命；任务；军事行动；传教
mission.usage: a historic mission历史使命；n.使命，任务；职责；宗旨；miss（送，放出）+ion（名词后缀）→送出→把东西送出去，这是你的使命→派遣；使命；索引p412

ex.en: My mission in this semester is to pass CET-6.
ex.zh: 我这学期的任务是通过大学英语六级考试。

ex.en: The spacecraft completed its ten-year mission to collect data from distant planets.
ex.zh: 航天器完成了为期十年的收集遥远行星数据的任务。

ex.en: The charity's mission is to provide clean drinking water to poor communities.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构的使命是为贫困社区提供清洁的饮用水。

missionary.usage: 助记:mission(传教)+ary(名词后缀表示人)→传教士；mission（使命）+ary（表示“人”的后缀）→肩负传教使命的人→传教士

ex.en: He spent 15 years as a missionary in Africa.
ex.zh: 他在非洲做了15年的传教士。

ex.en: Early missionary schools taught reading alongside religious instruction.
ex.zh: 早期的教会学校在讲授宗教内容的同时也教阅读。

ex.en: She has a missionary zeal for spreading the use of renewable energy.
ex.zh: 她怀着传教士般的热忱推广可再生能源的使用。

mist.usage: 助记:把山峰midst(中间)的d去掉就能看见mist(薄雾)

mistake.usage: 辨析:mistake普通用语,侧重理解和判断上的错误,可与error互换;词组there is no mistake about it毫无疑问;make no mistake这是肯定的；索引p412

ex.en: Admitting a mistake early can prevent far greater damage later.
ex.zh: 及早承认错误可以防止日后更大的损害。

ex.en: He mistook my politeness for agreement.
ex.zh: 他把我的礼貌误认为是同意。

ex.en: The bridge collapsed because of a fatal mistake in the design.
ex.zh: 这座桥因设计上的致命错误而坍塌。

misuse.usage: v.错用，滥用；虐待，不公平对 待 n.误用，滥用；索引p412

ex.en: Relying on ethical persuasion rather than law to address the misuse of body ideals may be the best step.
ex.zh: 依靠道德劝说而不是法律来应对理想身材标准的误用可能是最好的措施。

ex.en: The misuse of antibiotics is making some drugs increasingly ineffective.
ex.zh: 抗生素的滥用正使一些药物越来越失效。

ex.en: Employees caught misusing company equipment face immediate dismissal.
ex.zh: 滥用公司设备的员工一经发现将立即被解雇。

senses: n. 混合，混合物，混合剂(c)

phrases.p: a mixture of skepticism and optimism
phrases.m: 怀疑和乐观交织在一起

ex.en: Air is a mixture of gases, mainly nitrogen and oxygen.
ex.zh: 空气是气体的混合物，主要是氮气和氧气。

ex.en: The proposal received a mixture of praise and criticism.
ex.zh: 该提案得到的评价褒贬不一。

ex.en: The dish requires a mixture of flour, eggs and milk.
ex.zh: 这道菜需要面粉、鸡蛋和牛奶调成的混合物。

senses: v. 呻吟,呜咽；悲叹,哀悼,抱怨
n. 呻吟声；呼啸声；抱怨
moan.usage: 助记:看到moon(月亮)她忍不住moan(悲叹)起来；发音类似“哞”→牛有点难受，发出哞哞的“呻吟”声；索引p412

ex.en: Their rules, moan the banks, have forced them to report enormous losses.
ex.zh: 银行抱怨说，他们的（会计准则制定者所制定的）规则迫使他们报告巨额亏损。

ex.en: The injured man moaned in pain as he waited for the ambulance to arrive.
ex.zh: 受伤的男子在等待救护车到来时痛苦地呻吟。

ex.en: Instead of moaning about the workload, she quietly worked out a more efficient routine.
ex.zh: 她没有抱怨工作量大，而是默默设计出一套更高效的日常流程。

senses: n. (集合名词)暴徒,乌合之众,(盗贼等的)一群
vt. 成群暴动,聚众滋扰,团团围住某人
a. 非固定的；可移动的；流动的
adj. 可动的,活动的,运动的
mobile.usage: adj.活动的，可移动的；行动方 便的 n.手机

ex.en: More people now access the internet through mobile devices than through personal computers.
ex.zh: 现在通过移动设备上网的人比通过个人电脑的更多。

ex.en: A mobile library serves villages that have no bookstore of their own.
ex.zh: 流动图书馆为那些没有自己书店的村庄提供服务。

ex.en: Young graduates are highly mobile and willing to move abroad for work.
ex.zh: 年轻毕业生流动性很强，愿意为工作移居国外。

senses: n. 可动性,机动性,流动性

phrases.p: the high mobility of crop workers
phrases.m: 农作物工作者的高流动性

ex.en: Electric scooters have changed urban mobility for millions of commuters.
ex.zh: 电动滑板车改变了数百万通勤者的城市出行方式。

ex.en: Social mobility has slowed in many developed economies.
ex.zh: 许多发达经济体的社会流动性已经放缓。

ex.en: Poor mobility makes it hard for the elderly to live independently.
ex.zh: 行动不便使老年人难以独立生活。

mobilize.usage: mobil（可动的）+ize→使动起来→动员。近义：rally v. 召集；v.动员，组织；调动，调用

senses: ②(尤指为了取笑)模仿；③使失望；④挫败；向……挑战
n. ①嘲笑，讥笑；②(pl.) 模拟考试；adj. 仿制的，假装的；模拟的
mock.usage: 近ridicule vt.嘲笑；taunt vt.讥讽。mock exam模拟考；mockery n.嘲弄；索引p412

ex.en: Opponents mocked the plan as an expensive waste of time.
ex.zh: 反对者嘲笑该计划是昂贵的浪费时间之举。

ex.en: Students took a mock exam two weeks before the real test.
ex.zh: 学生在正式考试前两周参加了一次模拟考试。

ex.en: The talk show often mocks the empty promises of politicians.
ex.zh: 这档脱口秀经常嘲弄政客们空洞的承诺。

senses: n. 方式；风格；样式；（设备的）模式，工作状态
mode.usage: 发音类似"模(式)的"→模式；方式

ex.en: You can also use this computer game in two-player mode.
ex.zh: 你也可以在双人模式下使用这个电脑游戏。

ex.en: The aircraft can switch automatically between manual and automatic modes.
ex.zh: 这架飞机可以在手动和自动模式之间自动切换。

ex.en: Cycling is a cheap and healthy mode of transport.
ex.zh: 骑自行车是一种廉价而健康的出行方式。

senses: ②样式，模式；③模范，典型，榜样
vt. (仿特定样式或模式)做出，仿效，模仿；adj. 模范的，榜样的
model.usage: n.模型；样式；模特儿；范例 v.当模特儿；做成模型；使模仿

ex.en: The company introduced a new model of electric car this spring.
ex.zh: 该公司今年春天推出了一款新型电动汽车。

ex.en: Teachers should model the behaviour they expect from their pupils.
ex.zh: 教师应以身作则，示范自己期望学生做到的行为。

ex.en: Switzerland is often held up as a model of direct democracy.
ex.zh: 瑞士常被奉为直接民主的典范。

senses: adj. 一般的；温和的；适度的，适中的
adj. 适度的；合理的；温和的
moderate.usage: adj.中等的；温和的；有节制的 v.缓和，使适中；主持(讨论或 会议)；拓展: moderate views/policies 温和的见解/政策；小词有话说：真题出现6次，4次为完形选项且2次正确；一次考adj.适度的，一次考v.使缓和。；索引p412

ex.en: Even moderate amounts of the drug can be fatal.
ex.zh: 这种药的用量即使不很大也会致命。

ex.en: a moderate salary
ex.zh: 合理的工资

ex.en: Such bodily reaction might conceivably help moderate the effects of psychological stress.
ex.zh: 这样的身体反应可能有助于缓和心理压力的影响。

senses: a. 现代的；新式的；现代化的
adj. 现代的，近代的，新式的

ex.en: The modernization of the port will double its handling capacity.
ex.zh: 港口的现代化改造将使其吞吐能力翻一番。

ex.en: Modernization has brought both prosperity and social strain to the region.
ex.zh: 现代化给该地区带来了繁荣，也带来了社会压力。

ex.en: The government invested heavily in the modernization of rural schools.
ex.zh: 政府投入巨资推进农村学校的现代化。

senses: a. 谦虚的；些许的；庄重的；朴素的
adj. 谦虚的，谦逊的；适度的，不太大的
adj. 谦虚的，谦让的；些许的；不太大（或太贵、太重要等）的
adj. 适度的；谦虚的；普通的；(女性及其衣着)端庄的
modest.usage: 【记】他为人谦虚。近humble a.谦逊的；adj.谦虚的；端庄的；mode(方式)+est(联想成最高级的结尾形式)→做事方式极谦让；索引p412

ex.en: The court would be recklessly modest if it followed California's advice.
ex.zh: 如果法院采纳了加州的建议，那真是过于谦虚，不计后果。

ex.en: Despite his great achievements, the scientist remained modest about his success.
ex.zh: 尽管成就卓著，这位科学家对自己的成功仍很谦虚。

ex.en: The company reported a modest increase in profits compared with last year.
ex.zh: 与去年相比，该公司报告利润略有增长。

modesty.usage: n.谦虚，谦逊；端庄；modest 的派生词

ex.en: In his autobiography, Darwin himself speaks of his intellectual powers with extraordinary modesty.
ex.zh: 在他的自传中，达尔文本人非常谦虚地评价了自己的智力。

ex.en: Her modesty prevents her from talking about her achievements.
ex.zh: 谦逊使她不愿谈论自己的成就。

ex.en: He accepted the award with characteristic modesty.
ex.zh: 他以一贯的谦逊接受了奖项。

senses: v. 调整；修改；使更适合
vt. 稍作修改，改进；【语法】修饰
modify.usage: v.修改，改进；修饰，限定；mod(模式)+i(联想成I我)+fy(动词后缀)→随发展作出改变和调整；词根记忆：mod(fit, 使适合)+ify(动词后缀)→稍作修改；索引p412

ex.en: Patients are taught how to modify their diet.
ex.zh: 病人获得有关如何调节自己饮食的指导。

ex.en: Most importantly, it constantly modifies and enhances the games you play to build on the strengths you are developing.
ex.zh: 最为重要的是，它会不断地改进并加强你所玩的（训练）游戏，以增强你正在训练的（大脑的）能力。

ex.en: Engineers modified the engine design to reduce fuel consumption and noise.
ex.zh: 工程师修改了发动机设计，以降低油耗和噪音。

module.usage: 派生modular adj.标准化的,模块化的

senses: n. 大人物;权贵;大亨;雪丘

moist.usage: 助记:mist(薄雾)让空气moist(湿润)；发音类似“摸衣湿的”→天气太潮湿，一摸衣服居然有点湿了→潮湿的

ex.en: Keep the soil moist but not waterlogged.
ex.zh: 保持土壤湿润，但不要积水。

ex.en: The climate near the coast is warm and moist.
ex.zh: 海岸附近的气候温暖湿润。

ex.en: The cake stayed moist because of the syrup poured over it.
ex.zh: 由于浇了糖浆，蛋糕一直很湿润。

moisture.usage: 助记:moist(潮湿的)+ure(名词后缀)→潮湿；索引p412

ex.en: Plants absorb moisture from the soil through their roots.
ex.zh: 植物通过根从土壤中吸收水分。

ex.en: Excess moisture in the walls can lead to the growth of harmful mould.
ex.zh: 墙体中过多的湿气会滋生有害霉菌。

ex.en: The desert air is so dry that almost no moisture remains on the surface.
ex.zh: 沙漠空气非常干燥，地表几乎留不住任何水分。

senses: adj. 分子的,由分子组成的
adv. 短暂地,临时地,立刻

momentum.usage: 联想记忆：moment(瞬间)+um→运动员在起跑时瞬间向前冲→冲力；索引p412

ex.en: The reform campaign is gaining momentum across the country.
ex.zh: 这场改革运动正在全国形成越来越大的势头。

ex.en: The sledge gathered momentum as it slid down the slope.
ex.zh: 雪橇沿坡下滑时动量越来越大。

ex.en: Losing the early games drained the team's momentum for the rest of the season.
ex.zh: 开局失利耗尽了球队本赛季余下比赛的冲劲。

monarch.usage: 助记:mon(alone独自)+arch(ruler统治者)→君主;派生monarchist n.君主主义者;monarchy n.君主政体,君主制;monarchic adj.君主的;君主制度的；索引p412

ex.en: Under the new constitution, the monarch's power was limited by an elected parliament.
ex.zh: 根据新宪法，君主的权力受到民选议会的限制。

ex.en: The ceremony dates back to a time when the monarch personally led the army into battle.
ex.zh: 这一典礼可追溯到君主亲自率军出征的时代。

ex.en: Historians debate whether the monarch genuinely supported the reforms or merely accepted them.
ex.zh: 历史学家争论这位君主是真心支持改革，还是仅仅被动接受。

senses: n. 君主政体；君主国；王室
monarchy.usage: n.君主国；君主制；皇室；索引p412

senses: adj. 钱的；(尤指一国)货币的(或金融的)

ex.en: monetary reward
ex.zh: 赏金

ex.en: strict monetary policy
ex.zh: 严格的货币政策

ex.en: The central bank adjusted its monetary policy to control inflation and stabilize the currency.
ex.zh: 央行调整货币政策以控制通胀、稳定货币。

senses: （亦作monetise）vt. 通过……盈利；将（业务或资产）变现
v. 监控,监听,监测,监视

ex.en: However, Google and other big tech providers monitor their efficiency closely and make improvements.
ex.zh: 不过，谷歌和其他大型技术供应商都在密切监控其（指数据中心的）工作效率并做出改进。

ex.en: Doctors monitored the patient's heart rate throughout the operation.
ex.zh: 医生在整个手术过程中监测病人的心率。

ex.en: Regulators will monitor the banks more closely after the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 金融危机过后，监管机构将更加严密地监督各家银行。

senses: n. 只说一种语言的人

monologue.usage: n.长篇独白，独角戏；长篇大论；n.独白；长篇大论，滔滔不绝

senses: n. 垄断者(企业),专利者
n. 垄断；被垄断的商品（或服务）；独占，专利
monopoly.usage: [族] monopolise vt. 垄断；mono（单个）+poly（卖）→独家售卖→垄断。近义：domination n. 支配；n.垄断；垄断企业；mono（单一的）+poly（卖）→只能从这个地方买到→垄断；索引p412

ex.en: In recent years, railroads have been combining with each other, merging into supersystems, causing heightened concerns about monopoly.
ex.zh: 近年来，铁路系统一直在相互合并，形成超级系统，这加剧了人们对垄断的担忧。

ex.en: Regulators fined the giant company for abusing its monopoly in the search market.
ex.zh: 监管机构因这家巨头滥用其在搜索市场的垄断地位而对其处以罚款。

ex.en: The state railway lost its monopoly when private operators entered the market.
ex.zh: 当私营运营商进入市场后，国家铁路失去了垄断地位。

senses: a. 单调乏味的；毫无变化的
adj. 单调无聊的,毫无变化的
monotonous.usage: 反义: various；mono（单一的）+ton（想成tone"音调"）+ous（形容词后缀）→单一音调的→单调的；索引p412

ex.en: The housewives were asked if they found housework monotonous.
ex.zh: 家庭主妇们被问及是否觉得家务单调。

ex.en: Workers on the assembly line often describe their tasks as monotonous and exhausting.
ex.zh: 流水线上的工人常把自己的工作描述成单调而令人疲惫。

ex.en: The landscape became monotonous after hours of driving across the flat plain.
ex.zh: 在平坦的平原上驱车数小时后，景色变得单调起来。

senses: adj. 非常大(或好、坏、蠢等)的；纪念性的；重要的

mood.usage: in the mood 兴致勃勃；n.心境，情绪；气氛；心情不 好；我心情mood不好时就喜欢晚上静静地看月亮moon

ex.en: For instance, one of the apps the students are developing suggests movies based on your mood.
ex.zh: 例如，学生们正在开发的一个应用程序会根据你的心情推荐电影。

ex.en: The manager's cheerful mood spread through the office and improved the whole team's morale.
ex.zh: 经理愉快的心情感染了整个办公室，提升了全团队的士气。

ex.en: The bright colors of the paintings created a festive mood in the gallery.
ex.zh: 画作明快的色彩在美术馆里营造出节日般的氛围。

senses: a. 品行端正的；道德的
adj. 品行端正的,有道德的
moral.usage: [族]morality n. 道德；[近]ethical a. 伦理的；同义: ethical; 反义: immoral；m(妈妈)+oral(口头的)→妈妈口头教育要做有道德的人；派生morality n.道德；②n.寓意例为2021年完形；索引p412

ex.en: In some states, for example, jury duty was limited to persons of supposedly superior intelligence, education, and moral character.
ex.zh: 例如，在有些州，陪审团职责仅限于由那些所谓的智商、学历和道德品格高人一等的人来承担。

ex.en: The moral of the story is simple.
ex.zh: 这个故事的寓意很简单。

ex.en: The story teaches children a moral lesson about honesty and responsibility.
ex.zh: 这个故事给孩子们上了一堂关于诚实和责任的道德课。

senses: n. 道德(规范),伦理;美德
morality.usage: 同义: ethics；n.道德，品行；正当性

ex.en: The debate over cloning is as much about morality as about science.
ex.zh: 关于克隆的争论既是科学问题，也是道德问题。

ex.en: Writers of the Victorian period frequently questioned the conventional morality of their society.
ex.zh: 维多利亚时代的作家常常质疑当时社会的主流道德观念。

ex.en: Many people believe that a market economy needs a shared sense of morality to function well.
ex.zh: 许多人认为，市场经济的良好运转需要共同的道德观念。

morally.usage: adv.道德上，道义上；确实地， 确确切切地

ex.en: Moreover, some have been found to have a valuable function in building up soil fertility.
ex.zh: 此外，一些（树种）已经在提高土壤肥力方面具有重要作用。

ex.en: The plan is too costly; moreover, it ignores the needs of rural communities.
ex.zh: 该计划成本过高；而且，它忽视了农村社区的需求。

ex.en: The evidence is incomplete; moreover, parts of it contradict the witnesses' earlier accounts.
ex.zh: 证据不完整；而且，其中部分内容与证人先前的陈述相矛盾。

senses: a. 终将死亡的；致命的；极端的
adj. 致命的；终有一死的
adj. 终将死亡的；致命的

phrases.m: 殊死战,不死不休的战斗

mortal.usage: 辨析:mortal必死的指不能永存;fatal导致死亡;deadly可能致死；即便是道德高尚(moral)的人，也终有一死(mortal)；索引p412

ex.en: We are all mortal.
ex.zh: 我们都终有一死。

ex.en: In Greek myths, mortal heroes often received help from the gods on Mount Olympus.
ex.zh: 在希腊神话中，凡人英雄常常得到奥林匹斯山上诸神的帮助。

ex.en: The delay dealt a mortal blow to the company's already fragile reputation.
ex.zh: 这次延误给了公司本已脆弱的声誉致命一击。

ex.en: Mortality from lung cancer is still increasing.
ex.zh: 死于肺癌的人数仍在上升。

mortgage.usage: mort（死）+gage（抵押品）→以生命作担保的抵押→按揭。抵押人mortgagor；受押人mortgagee；为了获得贷款，他把自己最爱的摩托车（motorbike）抵押（mortgage）给哥哥了；索引p412

ex.en: He raised the money by taking out a second mortgage on his house.
ex.zh: 他通过对自己的房屋办理二次抵押筹集了这笔钱。

ex.en: Rising interest rates have made it harder for young families to qualify for a mortgage.
ex.zh: 利率上升使年轻家庭更难获得按揭贷款。

ex.en: They took out a mortgage to buy their first home near the coast.
ex.zh: 他们办理了按揭贷款，在海边买下了第一套住房。

senses: det./pron. 最多；大多数；几乎所有
adv. 几乎全部地,主要地,大部分,基本上
adv. 主要地，大部分地；一般地；通常

ex.en: In that decade, however, large numbers also migrated from California, mostly to other parts of the West.
ex.zh: 然而，在那十年里，也有大量的人从加利福尼亚州迁出，大部分去了西部的其他地区。

ex.en: Meanwhile, it has more than $120 billion in unfunded liabilities, mostly for employee health and retirement costs.
ex.zh: 同时，它（指美国邮政署）还背负着无资金准备的1,200多亿美元的债务，其中大部分是其员工医疗和养老方面的花费。

ex.en: The audience at the festival consists mostly of students and young professionals.
ex.zh: 艺术节的观众主要是学生和年轻上班族。

senses: vt. 做手势,点(或摇)头示意
n. 运动；移动；动作；动议，提议
motion.usage: 辨析:motion指与静相对的动(科技);movement指动作运动(社会思想);campaign本义战役,引申宣传鼓动；反义rest；n.运动，移动；动作；提议 v.打手势，示意；n.运动，移动；提议 v.打手势，示意；mot（=move，移动）+ion（名词后缀）→移动。

ex.en: Do not open the door when the train is in motion.
ex.zh: 列车行驶时不要打开车门。

ex.en: Parliament rejected the motion by a narrow margin after a heated debate.
ex.zh: 经过激烈辩论，议会以微弱差距否决了这项动议。

ex.en: Scientists studied the motion of the planets to work out the laws of gravity.
ex.zh: 科学家研究行星的运动，以求弄清引力定律。

senses: adj. 一动不动的，静止的
vt. 做为(某人行为)的动机;激发
motivate.usage: 派生motivation n.动机;motivated adj.有动机的；v.成为……的动机；激励，激 发；v.成为……的动机；激励，激发；motiv（motive动机）+ate（动词后缀）→使你有动机→刺激，激发。；词根记忆：mot(move, 推动)+iv+ate(使)→使不停地推动别人向前→激励；索引p412

ex.en: Not only are the tasks apparently infinite, the co-workers are much harder to motivate.
ex.zh: 不仅任务无穷无尽，同事们也很难被激励起来。

ex.en: George Osborne's scheme was intended to motivate the unemployed to report voluntarily.
ex.zh: 乔治·奥斯本的计划本是为了激励失业者主动申报。

ex.en: Managers use bonuses and praise to motivate employees to work more efficiently.
ex.zh: 管理者用奖金和表扬来激励员工更高效地工作。

ex.en: Failing at something can help you discover your truest friends, or help you find unexpected motivation to succeed.
ex.zh: 在某些事情上的失败可以帮助你找到最真诚的朋友，或者帮助你找到意想不到的成功动力。

senses: adj. 运动的,发动的,促进的
motive.usage: 同义aim,purpose；n.动机，目的，原因 adj.引起运动的，起推动作用 的；n.动机，目的，原因 adj.引起运动的，起推动作用的；mot（=move，移动）+ive（名词后缀）→使你动起来的东西→动机。

ex.en: But this effect is not a part of its original motive.
ex.zh: 但是这种影响并不是它最初动机的一部分。

ex.en: The police are still investigating the motive behind the attack on the warehouse.
ex.zh: 警方仍在调查这起仓库袭击事件背后的动机。

ex.en: Profit is a powerful motive, but many entrepreneurs also want to solve real social problems.
ex.zh: 利润是强大的动机，但许多创业者还想解决真实的社会问题。

motor.usage: n.发动机，马达；汽车 adj.机动的；汽车的

ex.en: The pump is driven by a small electric motor.
ex.zh: 这个泵由一台小型电动机驱动。

ex.en: The toy plane stops working whenever its motor overheats.
ex.zh: 玩具飞机的马达一过热就停止工作。

ex.en: Electric motors are quieter and need less maintenance than petrol engines.
ex.zh: 电动机比汽油发动机噪音更小，维护也更少。

senses: v. 安装,镶嵌,裱贴；装置

ex.en: Tension mounted as the deadline approached and no agreement had been reached.
ex.zh: 随着截止日期临近而仍未达成协议，紧张气氛不断加剧。

ex.en: The opposition mounted a strong challenge to the government's housing policy.
ex.zh: 反对派对政府的住房政策发起了有力挑战。

ex.en: She mounted the steps slowly, pausing now and then to admire the carved stone figures.
ex.zh: 她缓缓登上台阶，不时驻足欣赏那些石刻人像。

ex.en: The village lies at the foot of the highest mountain in the region.
ex.zh: 该村坐落在该地区最高山的山脚下。

ex.en: Streams from the mountains supply water to the entire valley.
ex.zh: 山间的溪流为整个山谷提供水源。

ex.en: They face a mountain of paperwork before the project can begin.
ex.zh: 项目开工之前，他们要处理堆积如山的文书工作。

senses: v. 哀悼；忧伤；对……感到痛心或遗憾
mourn.usage: 派生mournful adj.悲痛的,忧愁的；发音类似“默恩”→他默默“哀悼”他的恩人

ex.en: When our time of mourning is over, we press forward.
ex.zh: 当我们的忧伤结束后，我们继续前进。

ex.en: Fans around the world mourned the death of the singer.
ex.zh: 世界各地的歌迷哀悼这位歌手的离世。

ex.en: Environmentalists mourn the loss of wetlands to new housing estates.
ex.zh: 环保人士为湿地被新建住宅区侵占而痛心。

senses: adj. 悲哀的，令人伤心的
n. 嘴，口；口腔；（洞穴的）入口；入海口
n. (电话的)话筒;(乐器的)吹口
n. 喉舌;代言人;发言人
v. 移动,搬动；迁移,搬家
move.usage: 另:move on继续前进；派生movement n.运动,活动,移动,迁移；v.(使)移动；搬家；改变；前进， 进展；采取行动；使感动，打 动 n.行动；移动；改变；搬家；索引p412

ex.en: The company's decision to move its headquarters surprised both employees and investors.
ex.zh: 公司搬迁总部的决定让员工和投资者都感到意外。

ex.en: We were deeply moved by the courage of the rescue workers during the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水期间救援人员的勇气令我们深受感动。

ex.en: Negotiations moved slowly, and neither side seemed willing to make the first concession.
ex.zh: 谈判进展缓慢，双方似乎都不愿先作出让步。

senses: n. [C,U] 运动；移动；迁移；增减
n. 运动,活动,移动,迁移

ex.en: The environmental movement has pushed climate policy up the political agenda.
ex.zh: 环保运动推动气候政策在政治议程中的位置前移。

ex.en: Physiotherapy exercises can restore movement to injured joints.
ex.zh: 理疗锻炼可以恢复受伤关节的活动能力。

ex.en: The camera followed every movement of the dancer.
ex.zh: 摄像机跟拍了舞蹈演员的每一个动作。

phrases.m: 说某人坏话,企图破坏某人名声

senses: v. 行凶抢劫,打劫,给……拍照

phrases.m: 会说多种语言的年轻人

multinational.usage: 拆分:multi(many许多个)+national(国家的)→多国的；索引p412

ex.en: A century ago, few people regularly brushed their teeth multiple times a day.
ex.zh: 一个世纪前，很少有人习惯性地每天刷牙数次。

ex.en: The fire injured multiple people and destroyed three shops.
ex.zh: 大火使多人受伤，并烧毁了三家店铺。

ex.en: Twenty-eight is a common multiple of four and seven.
ex.zh: 二十八是四和七的公倍数。

multiply.usage: 反义：decrease v. 减少,缩小；派生 multiplication n. 增加,繁殖,乘法；multi（表示“多”）+ply（联想plus“加”）→多加→增加；繁殖。；索引p412

ex.en: Cigarette smoking multiplies the risk of cancer.
ex.zh: 抽烟会大大增加得癌症的风险。

ex.en: Bacteria multiply rapidly in food that is left at room temperature for too long.
ex.zh: 细菌在长时间放置于室温下的食物中迅速繁殖。

ex.en: To find the area of the room, simply multiply its length by its width.
ex.zh: 要算出房间的面积，只需把长乘以宽。

senses: vi. 同时执行多项任务
n. 众多；大量；群众；大批百姓；民众

ex.en: The library offers a whole multitude of books for young readers.
ex.zh: 图书馆为年轻读者提供大量书籍。

ex.en: A multitude of factors influence how children learn a language.
ex.zh: 大量因素影响着儿童学习语言的方式。

ex.en: The singer performed before a multitude of eager fans.
ex.zh: 歌手在一大群热切的歌迷面前演出。

senses: adj. 平凡的;单调的;世俗的

municipal.usage: muni（公共职责）+cip（承担）+-al→承担公共事务的→市政的。族municipality n.市政当局

murmur.usage: 拟声词：低沉连续的声音→喃喃。近whisper n.低语；mutter v.咕哝；索引p412

ex.en: She murmured an apology and slipped out of the room.
ex.zh: 她低声道了歉，悄悄溜出了房间。

ex.en: The crowd murmured its disapproval as the result was announced.
ex.zh: 结果宣布时，人群中响起低低的抱怨声。

ex.en: He fell asleep to the murmur of the stream outside his window.
ex.zh: 他伴着窗外溪水的潺潺低语声入睡了。

senses: n. 肌肉；体力；权力；影响力

ex.en: Swimming develops the muscles of the shoulders and back.
ex.zh: 游泳能锻炼肩部和背部的肌肉。

ex.en: The union flexed its muscle by calling a nationwide strike.
ex.zh: 工会通过号召全国罢工来展示自身实力。

ex.en: Regular stretching prevents muscle injuries during exercise.
ex.zh: 经常拉伸可以防止运动中肌肉受伤。

senses: adj. 肌肉的,肌肉发达的
adj. 肌肉的；肌肉发达的

ex.en: The young athlete's muscular arms impressed the selectors.
ex.zh: 这位年轻运动员肌肉发达的手臂给选拔者留下了深刻印象。

ex.en: Muscular strength declines naturally with age unless one keeps exercising.
ex.zh: 如果不坚持锻炼，肌肉力量会随年龄自然衰退。

ex.en: The disease attacks the muscular system and gradually weakens patients.
ex.zh: 这种疾病侵袭肌肉系统，使患者逐渐衰弱。

senses: a. 音乐的；擅长音乐的
adj. 音调优美的,悦耳的,喜欢音乐的
adj. 音乐的；有音乐天赋的；悦耳的

ex.en: The musical based on the novel has run for ten years in London.
ex.zh: 根据这部小说改编的音乐剧已在伦敦上演十年。

ex.en: The child shows remarkable musical ability, recognising tunes after one hearing.
ex.zh: 这个孩子显示出非凡的音乐天赋，听过一遍就能记住曲调。

ex.en: Her musical voice made the long narration pleasant to hear.
ex.zh: 她悦耳的嗓音使冗长的叙述听起来很悦耳。

ex.en: The street musician earned a living playing the violin outside the station.
ex.zh: 这位街头音乐家靠在车站外拉小提琴谋生。

ex.en: Many professional musicians began training before the age of ten.
ex.zh: 许多职业音乐家在十岁之前就开始接受训练。

ex.en: The festival invites musicians from more than twenty countries.
ex.zh: 音乐节邀请了来自二十多个国家的音乐家。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: modal v. 必须；一定；应该，得

mute.usage: 发音类似"没有他"→没有他的时候班里很沉默→沉默的

ex.en: The child sat mute in the corner.
ex.zh: 这孩子坐在屋子的角落里，一声不吭。

ex.en: He pressed the mute button during the long conference call.
ex.zh: 在冗长的电话会议中，他按下了静音键。

ex.en: She stared at the letter, mute with shock.
ex.zh: 她盯着那封信，震惊得说不出话来。

senses: vt.&vi. 轻声低语，咕哝；抱怨
adj. 互相的，彼此的；共同的，共有的
mutual.usage: mutual强调两者之间"共同的";common强调两者及两者以上"共同的"；mut（变换）+ual（有……性质的，属于……的）→变换的→互相的；真 mutual-fund assets 共同投资基金资产；索引p412

ex.en: Our relationship was based on mutual dependence.
ex.zh: 我们的关系建立在相互依存的基础上。

ex.en: This mutual gaze is a major part of the attachment between mother and child.
ex.zh: 这种互相注视是母子相互依恋的一个主要部分。

ex.en: The two companies signed the agreement out of mutual interest in green technology.
ex.zh: 两家公司出于对绿色技术的共同兴趣签署了协议。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

senses: pron. 我自己；我本人，亲自
adj. 神秘的,难以理解的,可疑的,不可思议的
adj. 神秘的；不易解释的；故弄玄虚的

ex.en: The whole thing was very mysterious.
ex.zh: 整件事非常神秘。

ex.en: A mysterious light appeared over the lake, and scientists have yet to explain it.
ex.zh: 湖面上空出现了一道神秘的光，科学家尚未给出解释。

ex.en: The writer is famous for mysterious characters whose pasts are never fully revealed.
ex.zh: 这位作家以塑造身世从不完全揭晓的神秘人物而闻名。

senses: n. 神秘,神秘的事物,不可思议(c/u)
n. 神秘的人或物；奥秘
mystery.usage: it's a mystery to sb. ……对某人来说是个谜

ex.en: There was a mystery guest on the programme.
ex.zh: 节目中有位神秘嘉宾。

ex.en: The disappearance of the ship remains a mystery after fifty years.
ex.zh: 五十年过去了，这艘船的失踪仍是一个谜。

ex.en: Scientists are slowly unravelling the mystery of how birds navigate at night.
ex.zh: 科学家正逐步揭开鸟类夜间如何导航的奥秘。

senses: n. 虚构的故事(人或事)
vt. 把……钉上,钉牢,钉住;使固定,使不动

phrases.p: hit the nail on the head

nail.usage: 又:nail a lie拆穿谎言;fight tooth and nail尽全力攻击以求胜

senses: adj. 幼稚的，天真的；轻信的
naive.usage: 源自法语，天生未经世故的→天真的。近innocent a.单纯的；childish a.幼稚的（贬）；辨析:naive介于artless与spontaneous间,又介于simple与innocent间；nai（奶）+ve（联想成“喂”）→他就像个需要喂奶的小孩，还没有长大，讲话也很天真→天真的。

ex.en: It was naive of him to believe the contract needed no lawyer.
ex.zh: 他相信这份合同不需要律师，实在天真。

ex.en: The report's conclusions strike experienced readers as naive.
ex.zh: 在有经验的读者看来，这份报告的结论很幼稚。

ex.en: She was naive enough to lend money to a complete stranger.
ex.zh: 她天真到把钱借给一个素不相识的人。

senses: adj. 裸体的,无遮蔽的,无掩饰的

phrases.m: 原原本本的事实,赤裸裸的事实

naked.usage: 辨析:naked指无必需物遮盖,语气强;bare部分裸露或物无遮掩;bald光秃的

nap.usage: 助记:他nap(打盹)时被snap(抓住了)

ex.en: The film's narrative jumps between past and present.
ex.zh: 这部电影的叙事在过去与现在之间来回跳跃。

ex.en: Politicians compete to control the public narrative about the economy.
ex.zh: 政客们竞相主导有关经济的公众叙事。

ex.en: The book is written in a simple narrative style suited to young readers.
ex.zh: 这本书以适合年轻读者的简洁叙事风格写成。

senses: adv. 狭窄地;严密地;仔细地
adj. 使人难受的,讨厌的;厉害的,严重的
adj. 极差的；令人厌恶的；令人不悦的
nasty.usage: 同义: dirty, messy, unpleasant; 反义: clean；adj.糟糕的，严重的；不友善 的；nas(鼻)+(t)y(表形容词)→鼻子总是流鼻涕→令人讨厌的

ex.en: This coffee has a nasty taste.
ex.zh: 这咖啡真难喝。

ex.en: He inherited a nasty financial situation when he took over the family firm.
ex.zh: 他接管家族企业时，接手的是一个棘手的财务烂摊子。

ex.en: A nasty storm knocked down power lines and left thousands of homes without electricity.
ex.zh: 一场猛烈的暴风雨刮断了电线，使数千户家庭断电。

nation.usage: n.国家，民族；国民；n.国家例为2015年翻译；索引p412

ex.en: This movement, driven by powerful and diverse motivations, built a nation out of a wilderness and, by its nature, shaped the character and destiny of an uncharted continent.
ex.zh: 这场（移民）运动在各种强大动机的推动下，在一片荒野之中创立了一个国家，而且就其本质而言，该运动也塑造了一个未知大陆的性格并决定了它的命运。

ex.en: The whole nation celebrated when the team won the championship for the first time.
ex.zh: 当球队首次夺得冠军时，举国欢庆。

ex.en: Industrialization transformed the nation from a farming society into a manufacturing power.
ex.zh: 工业化使这个国家从农业社会转变为制造业强国。

senses: adj. 民族的,国家的,国立的
adj. 国家的；民族的；国内的

phrases.m: 国民收入 / 少数民族

national.usage: ①adj.国家的:a national institution一个国家机构 ②adj.国内的；索引p412

ex.en: The government unveiled a national plan to improve adult literacy.
ex.zh: 政府公布了一项提高成人识字率的全国性计划。

ex.en: National income rose by two percent last quarter.
ex.zh: 上一季度国民收入增长了百分之二。

ex.en: The final match attracted a record national television audience.
ex.zh: 决赛吸引了创纪录的全国电视观众。

senses: adj. 全国范围的,全国性的
adj. 全国范围的；全国性的
nationwide.usage: adj.全国性的，全国各地的 adv.在全国；索引p412

ex.en: That is exactly what happened when Norway adopted a nationwide corporate gender quota.
ex.zh: 这正是挪威要求全国企业采纳性别配额时所发生的情况。

ex.en: The railway company launched a nationwide advertising campaign.
ex.zh: 这家铁路公司发起了全国范围的广告宣传活动。

ex.en: The new safety standards will apply nationwide from next January.
ex.zh: 新的安全标准将从明年一月起在全国范围内实施。

senses: a. 出生地的；本地的；与生俱来的
adj. 本地的,本国的;天生的
native.usage: adj.本地出生的，出生地的； 天生的

ex.en: The panda is native to the bamboo forests of central China.
ex.zh: 熊猫原产于中国中部的竹林。

ex.en: Her native language is Spanish, but she writes fluently in English.
ex.zh: 她的母语是西班牙语，但她能用英语流畅地写作。

ex.en: The museum celebrates the art of the island's native people.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆展示该岛原住民的艺术。

senses: adj. 土著的,土生土长的
adj. 天生的,天赋的,固有的
adj. 自然的；正常的；天赋的；本能的
natural.usage: adj.天然的；天生的 n.有天赋的人；natural sciences自然科学；natural selection自然选择；natural environment自然环境；②天赋的：natural talent天赋异禀；索引p412

ex.en: Many parents believe that children have a natural curiosity about the world around them.
ex.zh: 许多家长认为，孩子对周围的世界有着天然的好奇心。

ex.en: The region is rich in natural resources, including timber, coal, and fresh water.
ex.zh: 该地区自然资源丰富，包括木材、煤炭和淡水。

ex.en: She has a natural talent for languages and picked up French within a year.
ex.zh: 她有语言天赋，一年之内就学会了法语。

senses: n. 自然主义者,自然主义作家
adj. 顺从自然的；自然主义的
n. 入国籍；归化，自然化

nature.usage: n.大自然，天性；性格；本质；in nature本质上；事实上；索引p412

ex.en: Spending time in nature has been shown to reduce stress and improve concentration.
ex.zh: 事实证明，置身大自然可以减轻压力、提高专注力。

ex.en: The exact nature of the new substance is still being investigated by chemists.
ex.zh: 这种新物质的确切性质仍由化学家研究中。

ex.en: It is not in his nature to give up, even when the task seems impossible.
ex.zh: 即使任务看似不可能完成，放弃也不是他的本性。

senses: adj. 不听话的,坏的,惹麻烦的,刺激人的
adj. 航海的;船舶的;船员的
v. 航行，航海；导航；正确处理，有效应对
vt. 导航；航行；找到正确方法(对付困难、复杂的情况)
navigate.usage: v.导航，引路；航行；驾驶；浏 览；海军(navy)乘船出门(gate)航行(navigate)；词根记忆：nav(ship,船)+ig(drive,驾驶)+ate(动词后缀)→驾驶船→航行。；索引p412

ex.en: Many first-generation students struggle to navigate the middle-class culture of higher education.
ex.zh: 许多第一代大学生挣扎于应付高等教育中的中产阶级文化。

ex.en: If you get lost without a phone or a compass, and you literally can't find north, a few tricks may help you navigate back to civilization, one of which is to follow the land.
ex.zh: 如果你迷路了，又没带手机或指南针，确实找不到北，一些技巧或许能帮助你导航重返文明社会，其中之一便是沿着地势走。

ex.en: Many first-generation students "struggle to navigate the middle-class culture of higher education, learn the 'rules of the game,' and take advantage of college resources," they write.
ex.zh: 许多"初代"大学生"努力在高等教育的中产阶级文化里摸索，学习所谓的'游戏规则'，并充分利用大学资源，"他们(指作者)在文章中写道。

ex.en: Satellite navigation has made long-distance driving far easier than it was a generation ago.
ex.zh: 卫星导航使长途驾驶比上一代人那时容易得多。

ex.en: Early sailors depended on the stars for navigation across the open ocean.
ex.zh: 早期水手依靠星星在辽阔的大洋上导航。

ex.en: Thick fog made navigation through the narrow channel extremely dangerous.
ex.zh: 浓雾使在狭窄航道中航行变得极其危险。

ex.en: He joined the navy at eighteen and served on submarines.
ex.zh: 他十八岁加入海军，在潜艇上服役。

ex.en: The navy patrols the coast to deter illegal fishing.
ex.zh: 海军在沿海巡逻以遏制非法捕捞。

ex.en: The country's navy was modernised with new destroyers and frigates.
ex.zh: 该国海军装备了新型驱逐舰和护卫舰，实现了现代化。

nearby.usage: near（不远）+by（经过）→目的地离刚刚经过的地方不远→在附近

senses: adv. 必然地;不可避免地

ex.en: Higher spending does not necessarily lead to better outcomes.
ex.zh: 更高的支出未必带来更好的结果。

ex.en: A famous author is not necessarily a good writing teacher.
ex.zh: 知名作家未必是好的写作老师。

ex.en: The cheapest option is not necessarily the safest.
ex.zh: 最便宜的选择不一定是最安全的。

necessary.usage: adj.必要的，必需的；必然的 n.必需品；adj.必需的例为2018年完形；索引p412

ex.en: On the one hand, it's a necessary condition for many worthwhile things: child care, friendships, etc.
ex.zh: 一方面，对许多重要的事情来说，它（指信任）是必要条件，如照看孩子、建立友谊等。

ex.en: Good communication is necessary for any team that hopes to finish the project on time.
ex.zh: 良好的沟通对任何希望按时完成项目的团队都是必要的。

ex.en: It may become necessary to raise prices if raw material costs continue to climb.
ex.zh: 如果原材料成本持续攀升，提价可能势在必行。

necessitate.usage: necessit（必要）+-ate（动词后缀）→使成为必要。族necessary a.必要的；necessity n.必要性；索引p412

ex.en: The new security checks will necessitate longer waiting times at airports.
ex.zh: 新的安检将使机场的候检时间变长。

ex.en: Rising sea levels may necessitate the relocation of entire coastal communities.
ex.zh: 海平面上升可能迫使整个沿海社区迁移。

ex.en: The damage necessitated a complete rebuild of the bridge.
ex.zh: 损坏程度使大桥不得不彻底重建。

senses: n. 必要；需要；必需品；不可避免的情况

ex.en: At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity.
ex.zh: 与此同时，人们继续把火视为是一个需要被完全掌控且只在必要时才可释放的事物。

ex.en: For millions of workers, a car is not a luxury but a daily necessity.
ex.zh: 对数百万劳动者来说，汽车不是奢侈品，而是日常必需品。

ex.en: Necessity forced the villagers to invent simple tools from whatever materials they could find.
ex.zh: 生活的迫切需要迫使村民用能找到的各种材料制作简易工具。
